description: Change the channel page of a connected YouTube channel: description, keywords, country, default language, trailer for non-subscribers (a video id of this channel; empty string removes it), banner (https URL of a JPEG/PNG, at least 2048x1152, 16:9, max 6 MB) and per-language title/description (localizations, keys like de_DE or en_US). Only the fields you pass change. The channel name itself and creating or deleting channels are not possible through the YouTube API. Called by an agent, the change is parked for human approval.

banner_url.description: https URL of the banner image

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

default_language.description: Language of title and description, e.g. de

localizations.description: Per language: { en: { title, description } }. Merged into the existing ones; null for a language removes it.

unsubscribed_trailer.description: Video id shown to non-subscribers; empty string removes the trailer

name: update_youtube_channel
